title: Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A global bandit allocation framework for allocating test-time reasoning compute across instances.
该研究把不同问题间的测试时算力分配建模为 bandit 学习，在线估计难度并优先把预算给可解的困难问题。
why: It makes budget allocation a first-class trace field and warns that a single claimed feedback contract can conceal task-dependent judges and verifiers.
inclusion_reason: It makes budget allocation a first-class trace field and warns that a single claimed feedback contract can conceal task-dependent judges and verifiers.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The paper Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach (arXiv:2506.12721; ICLR 2026) studies allocation across a batch of evaluation queries rather than how much compute to spend inside one query. Uniform Best-of-N gives every query the same number of generations even though easy, hard-but-solvable, and effectively unsolvable items benefit differently from additional samples. The decision problem is therefore to maximize coverage or final-answer accuracy under one shared generation budget without knowing query difficulty in advance.

For this atlas, the important object is not a new training corpus. It is an inference-time allocation trace: query identifier, generated responses, reward-oracle scores or answer clusters, the current best response, active/eliminated status, per-round and cumulative compute, stopping reason, and final selected answer. The paper evaluates such policies but does not provide a versioned prompt manifest, per-query allocation logs, or a reusable trace release. Any claim about data quality or reusable lineage must therefore remain unknown.

论文《Strategic Scaling of Test-Time Compute: A Bandit Learning Approach》（arXiv:2506.12721；ICLR 2026）研究的是一批评测问题之间的算力分配，而不是单个问题内部应使用多少算力。统一 Best-of-N 给每个问题相同的生成次数，但简单题、困难但可解题和实际不可解题从额外采样中获得的收益不同。因此，决策目标是在事先不知道问题难度时，用同一个生成预算最大化覆盖率或最终答案准确率。

对本图谱而言，关键对象不是新的训练语料，而是推理时分配轨迹：问题标识、生成回答、reward oracle 分数或答案簇、当前最优回答、活跃或已淘汰状态、每轮与累计算力、停止原因和最终选择答案。论文评估了这类策略，但没有提供版本化提示清单、逐题分配日志或可复用轨迹发布。因此，任何关于数据质量或可复用 lineage 的结论都必须保持 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a pure-exploration-style bandit formulation in which each query is an arm and one pull generates one additional response. The base Elimination algorithm maintains an active query set and, in rounds, samples K responses for every active query. It updates the best observed response and removes a query when its oracle score reaches a threshold gamma. Unspent budget is thereby transferred from queries considered solved to queries that still appear uncertain. Outputs are the response set for coverage evaluation and the best-scoring response for accuracy evaluation.

The feedback contract is mixed and task-specific. The paper uses Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B for Llama-family MATH-500 runs, Gemini-3.0-Flash as an LLM judge for Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite, self-consistency for AIME25, and executable ground truth for LiveCodeBench; it also reports ground-truth-oracle analyses when available. Self-consistency eliminates a query after sufficient answer agreement rather than after a learned score. UCB, gap-based, and entropy exploration variants change which unresolved queries receive samples, and a per-query cap limits overspending.

Relative to uniform Best-of-N and two-stage explore-then-commit allocation, the main change is fully adaptive redistribution across queries without training an auxiliary allocator. The category fit is Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because allocation decisions, oracle outputs, eliminated queries, and budgets are first-class records; final benchmark answers alone cannot reconstruct them.

论文的核心贡献是一个 pure-exploration 风格的 bandit 建模：每个问题是一只 arm，每次 pull 都为该问题再生成一个回答。基础 Elimination 算法维护活跃问题集合，并按轮次为每个活跃问题采样 K 个回答；它更新当前最高分回答，当 oracle 分数达到阈值 gamma 时淘汰该问题。由此，已被视为解决的问题不再消耗预算，剩余算力转移给仍不确定的问题。输出包括用于 coverage 评估的回答集合和用于 accuracy 评估的最高分回答。

反馈契约是混合且依任务而变的。论文在 Llama 系列的 MATH-500 实验中使用 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B，在 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 上使用 Gemini-3.0-Flash 作为 LLM judge，在 AIME25 上使用 self-consistency，在 LiveCodeBench 上使用可执行 ground truth；有条件时还报告 ground-truth oracle 分析。self-consistency 版本依据答案达到足够一致来淘汰问题，而不是依据学习到的分数。UCB、gap-based 和 entropy 探索变体改变未解决问题的采样优先级，每题上限则限制过度分配。

与统一 Best-of-N 和两阶段 explore-then-commit 分配相比，关键变化是在不训练辅助 allocator 的情况下跨问题全程自适应重分配。它属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为分配决策、oracle 输出、淘汰状态和预算都是一等记录；只有最终 benchmark 答案无法重建这些过程。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are a query set S, a total generation budget B, a response generator, a reward oracle r, a per-round batch size K, and an elimination threshold gamma. Each round generates K new responses for every active query, scores them, preserves all responses and the best-so-far candidate, and removes a query whose best new score reaches gamma. The run stops when B is exhausted or the active set is empty. Coverage asks whether any retained response is correct; accuracy asks whether the selected best response is correct. The default cost unit is one complete generation, while an extension accounts for token budgets.

The paper instantiates selection and stopping differently by benchmark. MATH-500 combines learned PRM, LLM-judge, and ground-truth variants; AIME25 uses answer self-consistency; LiveCodeBench uses execution correctness. Experiments use Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, Qwen3-4B, and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite. Reported average budgets are 4, 8, 16, and 32 generations, except smaller Gemini budgets; generation temperature is 0.6, results are averaged over four random runs, and Qwen3-4B uses a 38,912-token maximum. The two-stage baseline searches stage-one ratios of 25%, 50%, and 75% and reports the best.

A reproducible trace should retain prompt version, model and sampler configuration, every response, raw and normalized oracle result, oracle identity, answer equivalence rule, K, gamma, max-sample cap, active-set updates, token counts, random seed, and final selection. No official code, allocation-history dataset, or versioned experiment log is linked in the accepted metadata, so executable fidelity, exact seeds, release license, and trace completeness remain unknown.

输入包括问题集合 S、总生成预算 B、回答生成器、reward oracle r、每轮批量 K 和淘汰阈值 gamma。每轮为所有活跃问题生成 K 个新回答并评分，保留全部回答和当前最优候选；若某题的新最高分达到 gamma，就将其从活跃集合移除。预算耗尽或活跃集合为空时停止。coverage 判断保留回答中是否至少有一个正确答案，accuracy 判断最终最高分回答是否正确。默认成本单位是一条完整生成，扩展版本也可按 token 预算计费。

论文按 benchmark 使用不同的选择和停止方式。MATH-500 包含学习型 PRM、LLM judge 和 ground-truth 变体；AIME25 使用答案 self-consistency；LiveCodeBench 使用执行正确性。实验模型包括 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Qwen3-4B 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite。报告的平均预算通常为 4、8、16、32 次生成，Gemini 使用更小预算；生成 temperature 为 0.6，结果取四次随机运行平均，Qwen3-4B 的最大长度为 38,912 token。两阶段基线在 25%、50%、75% 的第一阶段预算比例中选择并报告最佳结果。

可复现轨迹应保留提示版本、模型与采样配置、每个回答、原始和归一化 oracle 结果、oracle 身份、答案等价规则、K、gamma、每题采样上限、活跃集合更新、token 计数、随机 seed 和最终选择。已接受元数据没有链接官方代码、分配历史数据或版本化实验日志，因此可执行一致性、准确 seed、发布许可证和轨迹完整性仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates MATH-500, AIME25, and 479 LiveCodeBench items, comparing adaptive allocation with uniform Best-of-N and a tuned two-stage baseline under shared average budgets. It reports improved coverage or accuracy in many configurations, including a 7.41-point LiveCodeBench coverage gain for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at average budget 8 and larger gains in some other model-oracle settings. Results are averaged over four runs, and ablations cover allocation rules, thresholds, token budgets, and streaming queries.

These results support the narrower claim that adaptive cross-query allocation can outperform the studied allocation baselines under the paper's generators, oracle choices, and budget accounting. They do not establish that PRM or LLM-judge labels are correct, that the derived MATH-500-Hard subsets are model-independent, or that unreleased allocation traces are high-quality reusable data. The hard subsets are defined using whether the evaluated model succeeds within specified compute, so their difficulty status is tied to that model and protocol. The authoritative public source checked here is https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12721; no official reusable trace or code artifact was confirmed from the accepted links.

论文在 MATH-500、AIME25 和 479 个 LiveCodeBench 条目上评估自适应分配，并在相同平均预算下与统一 Best-of-N 及调优后的两阶段基线比较。论文在多种配置中报告 coverage 或 accuracy 提升，其中包括 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在平均预算 8 时 LiveCodeBench coverage 提高 7.41 个百分点；某些其他模型与 oracle 组合的增益更大。结果取四次运行平均，消融覆盖分配规则、阈值、token 预算和流式问题。

这些结果只支持较窄的结论：在论文采用的生成器、oracle 和预算口径下，跨问题自适应分配可优于所研究的分配基线。它们不能证明 PRM 或 LLM judge 标签正确，也不能证明派生的 MATH-500-Hard 子集与模型无关，更不能证明未发布的分配轨迹是高质量可复用数据。困难子集依据被评估模型能否在指定算力内成功来定义，因此难度状态绑定于该模型和协议。此处核验的权威公开来源是 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12721；从已接受链接中未确认官方可复用轨迹或代码 artifact。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier test-time scaling commonly chooses a per-query sampling budget or applies the same Best-of-N budget to every item. Related multi-query methods use an initial uniform exploration stage and then commit to a fixed allocation. This work instead treats the entire query batch as an online allocation problem: solved-looking queries leave an active set, and their remaining budget is reassigned while evidence accumulates. The entropy variant further uses diversity of observed answer patterns to prioritize difficult instances.

The direction signal is the explicit separation of generator, allocation policy, aggregation rule, and reward oracle. It shows why a test-time trace schema needs cross-instance fields—global budget, allocation rounds, elimination events, and unused-budget transfers—not only per-response scores. It also exposes that one headline method can rely on PRM, LLM judge, self-consistency, or execution depending on the task.

Bandit theory, Best-of-N generation, self-consistency, PRMs, and execution verification are not individually new. The novelty is their cross-query allocation formulation and adaptive policy. Reported benchmark gains are a policy-evaluation signal, not evidence that the underlying responses, oracle scores, or logs form a validated dataset.

以往测试时扩展通常为每个问题选择一个采样预算，或对所有条目使用相同的 Best-of-N 预算。相关多问题方法先进行统一探索，再固定后续分配。本文改为把整批问题视为在线分配问题：看似已解决的问题退出活跃集合，随着证据累积，其剩余预算被重新分配。entropy 变体还依据已观察答案模式的多样性来优先处理困难实例。

其方向性信号是明确拆分生成器、分配策略、聚合规则和 reward oracle。这说明测试时轨迹 schema 需要跨实例字段，例如全局预算、分配轮次、淘汰事件和未用预算转移，而不能只有逐回答分数。它也揭示了同一标题下的方法会随任务改用 PRM、LLM judge、self-consistency 或执行验证。

Bandit 理论、Best-of-N 生成、self-consistency、PRM 和执行验证本身都不是新概念。新意在于跨问题分配建模及其自适应策略。报告的 benchmark 增益是策略评估信号，不是底层回答、oracle 分数或日志已构成经验证数据集的证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The theoretical separation assumes independent response correctness and an oracle threshold that identifies correctness exactly or approximately; learned PRMs and LLM judges can violate that assumption. Early false-positive elimination can freeze a wrong answer, while false negatives waste budget. Oracle scales are not directly comparable across tasks, and the best threshold gamma may use expert knowledge or held-out tuning.

Compute is primarily counted as generations, although response lengths and oracle costs differ; token-budget experiments narrow but do not remove this accounting issue. MATH-500-Hard is constructed from model-specific failure within a budget and should not be treated as an intrinsic difficulty label. The paper does not release per-query allocations, raw scores, rejected responses, prompts as a versioned bundle, seeds, or an executable environment. Dataset licenses, decontamination controls, and prompt overlap audits are not established in the Card metadata. Benchmark improvements cannot substitute for these missing audit records.

理论对比假设回答正确性相互独立，并假设 oracle 阈值能精确或近似识别正确性；学习型 PRM 和 LLM judge 可能违反该假设。过早的 false positive 淘汰会固定错误答案，false negative 则会浪费预算。不同任务的 oracle 分数量纲不可直接比较，最佳阈值 gamma 还可能依赖专家知识或 held-out 调参。

论文主要按生成次数计费，但回答长度和 oracle 成本并不相同；token 预算实验缩小了问题，却不能完全消除口径差异。MATH-500-Hard 根据特定模型在给定预算内的失败构造，不能视为内在难度标签。论文没有发布逐题分配、原始分数、拒绝回答、版本化提示包、seed 或可执行环境。Card 元数据也未确认数据集许可证、去污染控制和提示重叠审计。benchmark 提升不能替代这些缺失的审计记录。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, this paper supplies a concrete schema for global allocation logs. A reusable record should join each response to its query, allocation round, generator settings, oracle type and version, raw score or answer cluster, elimination decision, token cost, and global remaining budget. Coverage and final-answer accuracy should remain separate, as should oracle-predicted success and ground-truth correctness.

Such traces could support allocator research, counterfactual replay under alternative thresholds, verifier calibration, budget-normalized comparisons, and analysis of whether compute shifts toward solvable rather than merely difficult queries. They could also expose where performance comes from: more samples, a stronger oracle, a different aggregation rule, or the bandit policy itself. Those uses require released logs or a faithful reimplementation; the present paper and accepted artifacts do not by themselves provide a ready-to-train dataset.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 方向，这篇论文给出了全局分配日志的具体 schema。可复用记录应把每个回答关联到问题、分配轮次、生成设置、oracle 类型与版本、原始分数或答案簇、淘汰决策、token 成本和剩余全局预算。coverage 与最终答案 accuracy 应分开，oracle 预测成功与 ground-truth 正确性也应分开。

这类轨迹可用于研究 allocator、在不同阈值下进行 counterfactual replay、校准 verifier、开展预算归一化比较，以及分析算力是否流向可解问题而不只是困难问题。它们还可区分性能来源：更多采样、更强 oracle、不同聚合规则，还是 bandit 策略本身。实现这些用途需要发布日志或忠实复现；当前论文和已接受 artifacts 本身并未提供可直接训练的数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Each query is a bandit arm; one unit of default compute is one generated response.
  • Elimination reallocates budget after an oracle score or self-consistency signal crosses a threshold.
  • Feedback differs by task: PRM, LLM judge, self-consistency, and executable ground truth are not interchangeable.
  • Reported gains evaluate allocation policies under specified budgets; they do not validate unreleased trace quality.
  • Reuse requires per-query allocation, oracle, prompt, seed, and token-cost logs that are not confirmed as released.

• 每个问题是一只 bandit arm；默认的一单位算力是一条生成回答。
  • 当 oracle 分数或 self-consistency 信号越过阈值后，Elimination 会把预算重新分配。
  • 反馈随任务而变：PRM、LLM judge、self-consistency 和可执行 ground truth 不可互换。
  • 报告增益是在指定预算下对分配策略的评估，不能验证未发布轨迹的质量。
  • 复用需要逐题分配、oracle、提示、seed 和 token 成本日志，目前未确认这些记录已发布。
